basics.name: Zihao Wang
basics.label: Undergraduate Student
basics.summary: B.Sc. candidate in Psychology (Qiushi Honor's Program) at Zhejiang University, with research interests in consciousness, mental imagery, and aphantasia.

education.area: Psychology: Interdisciplinary Frontiers of Behaviour and Mind in the Age of AI

research.name: Zhejiang University, in collaboration with Dr. Jianghao Liu (Paris Brain Institute, ICM) and the University of Sussex
research.summary: Neural mechanisms of conscious access to visual mental imagery in aphantasia
highlights: Co-designed the study and set up the experimental platform at Zhejiang University; responsible for data collection.
Tests whether imagery signals in aphantasia fail to be generated or fail to reach conscious access, using behavioural psychophysics together with electrophysiological and neuromodulation approaches.
